name: Firefly Jar
blurb: Catch glowing fireflies and fill the jar until it sparkles
about: The sun is setting over a quiet meadow, and the fireflies are out. Reach out or cup your hands near one to catch it - it follows your hand. Carry it to the glass jar in the middle and watch the jar glow a little brighter. Fill it all the way and every firefly flies free in a big sparkle, ready to catch again. Play on your own or with a friend.
